title: Tornado warning in Lancaster County
summary: A storm with rotation moves toward the city of Lancaster. NWS issues a Tornado Warning. Shows why there is no route button for tornadoes: you take shelter instead.

alerts.headline: TORNADO WARNING FOR CENTRAL LANCASTER COUNTY UNTIL 30 MINUTES FROM NOW
alerts.description:
SIMULATED ALERT. At this time, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado was located near Heath Springs, moving northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.
SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.
IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
alerts.instruction: SIMULATED. TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows.

alerts.headline: TORNADO WATCH IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 PM
alerts.description: SIMULATED ALERT. Tornado Watch 512 is in effect for Chester, Lancaster, Kershaw, and York counties.
